purpose: Shared compact confirmation surface for UI-owned panels.

input.action_id: Stable action identifier supplied by the calling panel.
input.title: Reader-facing title.
input.context: Opaque UI context returned unchanged to the caller.

rules: The component renders only supplied UI copy and never decides gameplay outcomes.
The caller validates the action again after confirmation.
Danger tone is visual emphasis only and does not bypass gameplay checks.
Panels must reuse this component instead of creating system-native or duplicated confirmation styles.
